# Pack Manifest V1

The pack v1 manifest body (engine contract §12), standalone from `grimoire_assets::PackError`
until Plan-0002 WP8.3 (see this file's header comment).

Format version **1**.

This page is generated from `schema/pack_manifest_v1.gschema` by `grimoire_schemagen` (project ADR-0011); the
generated Rust types live next to the crate that owns this format. Frame/pack framing
logic (length prefixes, header, handshake) is documented in the engine contract
(`docs/architektur/crate-vertraege.md`), not repeated here.

## `PackManifestBody` (struct)

The manifest section of a pack v1 file: compiler provenance, one path per TOC entry (in TOC
order), and an opaque application-defined block. Ends exactly at the end of the file; no
timestamp anywhere, so identical inputs produce byte-identical manifests.

| Field | Wire type | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| `manifest_version` | u32 | Manifest format version; `1` in this version of the format. |
| `compiler` | Str16≤64 | Name of the tool that produced the pack (e.g. `sigilc`). |
| `compiler_version` | Str16≤64 | Version string of that tool. |
| `entry_count` | u32 | Number of entries; must equal the pack's TOC entry count. |
| `paths` | Vec≤65536<Str16≤255> (count = `entry_count`, no separate wire count) | One path per TOC entry, in TOC order (`AssetPath`, at most 255 bytes each); count is `entry_count` above, not a separate wire count. |
| `application` | Bytes≤65536 | Opaque application-defined block (e.g. a game version string), at most 64 KiB. |
